kv_cache_formula.equation: kv_gb = (2 * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * bytes_per_elem * context_tokens) / (1024 ** 3)
kv_cache_formula.approx_estimator_bytes_per_token: weights_gb / 14.0 * 0.000085 GB/tok at fp16 (~0.28x for q4_0, ~0.52x for q8_0)
kv_cache_formula.turing_t4_note: On Turing Tesla T4 (sm_75), quantized KV cache (q4_0) works reliably with standard attention or modern llama-server -fa; older llama-cpp-python CUDA wheels can assert k->type == GGML_TYPE_F16 when combining flash_attn=True with q4_0—always test fallback flash_attn=False on T4.

IQ3_M.cpu_notes: 27% smaller bus transfer than Q4_K_M; ideal for 80B-109B MoE in 51GB RAM

IQ4_XS.cpu_notes: Imatrix LUT decoded via vpshufb; 3.63x faster prefill on ik_llama.cpp -rtr than mainline Q4_K_M

sdxl-turbo.name: SDXL-Turbo (6.5GB VRAM • SOTA 1024x1024 Art)
sdxl-turbo.notes: Produces high-fidelity 1024x1024 images in 1-2 steps. Exceptional detail, artistic textures, and lighting. On a Single T4 (14.5GB), pairing with a 14B model is tight—Text Focus Mode will automatically evict it when context expands.
sdxl-turbo.recommended_for: Production illustration, game concept art, and high-resolution backgrounds

sdxl-lightning.name: SDXL-Lightning (6.5GB VRAM • 2-4 Step Fast SOTA)
sdxl-lightning.notes: ByteDance's distilled lightning model. Generates 1024x1024 photorealistic art in only 2-4 steps (~1.2s on T4). Combines SOTA SDXL visual coherence with near-real-time generation.
sdxl-lightning.recommended_for: Rapid prototyping, game asset rendering, and high-res concept art

animagine-xl-3.1.name: Animagine XL 3.1 (6.6GB VRAM • SOTA Anime/Art Uncensored)
animagine-xl-3.1.notes: The undisputed community champion for uncensored anime, character design, and painterly concept art. Zero corporate refusal filters, unparalleled mastery of anime aesthetics, clothing tags, and cinematic composition. Runs in 6.6GB VRAM on Colab or Kaggle.
animagine-xl-3.1.recommended_for: Game character art, concept design, illustrations, and unconstrained creative workflows

mobius.name: Mobius DPO (6.6GB VRAM • SOTA Photorealism Uncensored)
mobius.notes: Trained using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to push image aesthetic scores to maximum. Produces dramatic hyper-detailed textures, lighting, and cinematic surrealism without corporate guardrails.
mobius.recommended_for: Cinematic wallpapers, hyper-detailed fantasy art, and book covers

realvisxl-v4.name: RealVisXL V4.0 (6.6GB VRAM • SOTA Cinema/Anatomy Uncensored)
realvisxl-v4.notes: The benchmark for raw photorealism. Excels at human skin textures, eyes, natural lighting, and studio cinematography without the waxy or artificial look common in corporate models. Fully uncensored.
strengths: Lifelike skin pores and natural eyes
realvisxl-v4.recommended_for: Photorealistic portraits, real-world scenes, and cinematic lighting studies

realvisxl-v5.name: RealVisXL V5.0 (6.6GB VRAM • SOTA Photorealism & Cinema)
realvisxl-v5.notes: The absolute benchmark for lifelike human skin textures, realistic lighting, and studio cinematography without waxy plastic artifacts. Fully uncensored.
realvisxl-v5.recommended_for: Photorealistic portraits, real-world scenes, and cinematic lighting

flux-1-schnell.name: FLUX.1-schnell (23.8GB VRAM • 12B Giant DiT Kaggle 30GB)
flux-1-schnell.architecture: 12B Rectified Flow Transformer + T5-XXL Text Encoder
flux-1-schnell.notes: Black Forest Labs' 12B parameter flagship flow-matching transformer. Generates astonishing typographical rendering, complex multi-object composition, and photorealism in just 4 steps. Demands ~23.8GB VRAM: uses the full 30GB VRAM of Kaggle Dual-T4!
flux-1-schnell.recommended_for: Kaggle Dual-T4 maximum image generation, posters with typography, and complex scenes

flux-dev-uncensored.name: FLUX.1-dev Abliterated V2 GGUF (10.5GB VRAM • 12B Uncensored Q4_K_M)
flux-dev-uncensored.architecture: 12B FLUX.1-dev Abliterated GGUF + 4-bit T5-XXL + FP32 VAE + CPU Offload
flux-dev-uncensored.notes: Verified working uncensored 12B FLUX.1-dev Abliterated GGUF recipe. Combines Q4_K_M GGUF transformer with 4-bit BnB T5-XXL, FP32 VAE, and model CPU offload to run cleanly on 15GB Tesla T4 with zero PEFT key errors.
strengths: Clean GGUF weights (no broken PEFT keys)
flux-dev-uncensored.recommended_for: Unrestricted 12B FLUX generation on Colab T4, L4, or Kaggle Dual-T4

flux-uncensored-v2.name: Chroma1-HD GGUF (10.2GB VRAM • 8.9B Uncensored Apache-2.0)
flux-uncensored-v2.architecture: 8.9B Chroma1-HD GGUF + 4-bit T5-XXL + FP32 VAE + CPU Offload
flux-uncensored-v2.notes: Apache-2.0 uncensored FLUX-derived 8.9B model quantized to GGUF. High anatomical fidelity and zero censorship, running cleanly on 15GB T4 with 4-bit T5-XXL and CPU offload.
strengths: Fits 15GB T4 via GGUF + CPU offload
flux-uncensored-v2.recommended_for: Unrestricted creative & character generation on Colab T4 or Kaggle

illustrious-xl.name: Illustrious-XL v2.0 (6.8GB VRAM • SOTA Anime 1536x1536)
illustrious-xl.notes: The new gold standard anime and game asset diffusion model. Succeeds Animagine XL with native 1536x1536 resolution, superior anatomical hands/faces, and dual prompt support (Danbooru tags + natural language prose). Runs in 6.8GB VRAM on Colab or Kaggle.
illustrious-xl.recommended_for: Visual novel character sprites, event CGs, anime illustrations, and game wallpapers

illustrious-xl-v2.name: Illustrious-XL v2.0 Diffusers (6.8GB VRAM • Native 1536x1536)
illustrious-xl-v2.notes: Gold standard anime model with diffusers-native weights. Native 1536x1536 rendering with dual tag + natural prose prompting.
illustrious-xl-v2.recommended_for: Visual novel character sprites, event CGs, anime illustrations

noobai-xl.name: NoobAI-XL V-Pred (7.0GB VRAM • Modern Anime Aesthetic)
noobai-xl.notes: Features V-Prediction formulation delivering dramatic anime studio lighting, deep saturation, and dynamic action poses. Note: Requires low CFG (1.5-3.5) with Euler sampler to avoid oversaturation.
noobai-xl.recommended_for: Dynamic action visual novel scenes, battle sprites, and cover illustrations

noobai-xl-vpred.name: NoobAI-XL V-Pred 1.0 (7.0GB VRAM • V-Pred Zero-SNR SOTA Anime)
noobai-xl-vpred.notes: Features V-Prediction zero-SNR scheduler delivering dramatic studio lighting, deep saturation, and dynamic action poses with Euler sampler.
noobai-xl-vpred.recommended_for: Dynamic action visual novel scenes, battle sprites, and cover illustrations

pony-v6-xl.name: Pony Diffusion V6 XL (6.8GB VRAM • Uncensored Character Master)
pony-v6-xl.notes: The community standard for uncensored character art, intricate poses, and mature visual novel romance scenes. Automatically configured with clip_skip=2 for optimal facial fidelity. Compatible with thousands of community LoRAs.
pony-v6-xl.recommended_for: Mature visual novel scenes, intimate character interactions, and customized LoRA workflows

sd-3.5-medium.name: SD 3.5 Medium (5.5GB VRAM • 2.5B MMDiT Fast Art)
sd-3.5-medium.notes: Stability AI's 2.5B MMDiT architecture. Delivers exceptional typography (spelling words directly on signs, banners, and game logos) and complex multi-subject composition. Runs with low ~5.5GB VRAM footprint on a Single T4 GPU.
sd-3.5-medium.recommended_for: Game logos, item icons with text, environmental signs, and UI assets

flux-1-dev.name: FLUX.1 [dev] (32GB VRAM • 12B Guidance DiT Modal A100)
flux-1-dev.notes: Black Forest Labs' flagship 12B model with non-commercial guidance distillation. Significantly superior prompt adherence, human anatomy, hands, and typography over Schnell. Requires ~32GB VRAM (full unquantized BF16 weights); runs smoothly on Modal A100-40GB / A100-80GB.
flux-1-dev.recommended_for: Modal A100-80GB / H100 studio-grade key art, book covers, and high-fidelity concept design

trellis-3d.name: Microsoft TRELLIS (24GB VRAM • SOTA Image-to-3D GLB/Gaussian)
trellis-3d.architecture: Rectified Flow DiT + 3D Structured Latents (SLAT) + Gaussian Decoder
trellis-3d.notes: Microsoft's breakthrough image-to-3D model. Produces high-resolution textured 3D meshes (GLB) and 3D Gaussian Splats from a single 2D image in under 15 seconds on an A10G or A100. Ideal for generating 3D game props, character models, and environmental assets directly from 2D concepts.
strengths: Full textured GLB meshes & Gaussian Splats in <15s
High geometric fidelity and PBR textures
trellis-3d.recommended_for: Modal A10G / A100 instant 3D asset generation, game development, and VR props

hunyuan3d-2.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2.0 (32GB VRAM • High-Res 3D Mesh Studio)
hunyuan3d-2.notes: Tencent's next-generation 3D generative model. Emits production-ready watertight 3D meshes with 2048x2048 UV texture maps. Handles intricate hair, cloth folds, and inorganic mechanical details. Requires 32GB VRAM on Modal A100-40GB / A100-80GB.
strengths: Watertight production meshes with 2k UV textures
hunyuan3d-2.recommended_for: Modal A100-80GB game-ready 3D character and environment production

wan2.1-14b-video.name: Wan2.1 14B (36GB VRAM • SOTA Flow DiT Video Generator)
wan2.1-14b-video.notes: Alibaba Wan-AI's groundbreaking 14B open-source text-to-video and image-to-video foundation model. Outperforms proprietary video generators on temporal consistency, dynamic physical motion, and cinematic lighting. Demands ~36GB VRAM: runs on Modal A100-80GB / H100.
strengths: SOTA open video generation beating closed APIs
Complex physical interactions and fluid motion
wan2.1-14b-video.recommended_for: Modal A100-80GB / H100 cinematic video cutscenes, animated character portraits, and trailers

hunyuan-video.name: Tencent HunyuanVideo (40GB VRAM • 13B DiT Video SOTA)
hunyuan-video.notes: Tencent's high-definition open video transformer. Features dual-stream spatio-temporal attention for extraordinary photorealism and camera movement stability. Requires 40GB VRAM on Modal A100-80GB or H100.
strengths: Dual-stream attention for rock-solid temporal coherence
Photorealistic rendering of human faces and hands in motion
hunyuan-video.recommended_for: Modal A100-80GB high-fidelity character animations and cinematic video production
